# How much does it cost to hire a company to build an AI agent?

As of October 2026, **a realistic budget is \$10,000–\$50,000 for a typical custom business AI agent**, although a simple agent can cost just a few thousand dollars and a complex enterprise system can exceed \$250,000. The biggest factors are what the agent needs to do, which business systems it must connect to, and how reliably and securely it needs to operate. [www.nerdheadz.com](https://www.nerdheadz.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ayautomate.com](https://www.ayautomate.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[botgigs.com](https://botgigs.com/lp/ai-agent-development-company?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 1\. Typical AI agent development costs

![AI Agent Development Services | Autonomous AI Workflow Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YoY7Pk96QoilAX_ubPIAi8B7eHPS7X0XoSoNkEbbPT-WnUlDWSZ2ysijufCYRGURYrB9M2F1teK2jR3mHDr4UdWjLSvE3mgzItoPhYRExUbJ_-QmUJCfRjsBOxUbRB-yA_OwM7Sb9G_mbpXwKB6KwuI00Ml6X6JZklIneujsDACTRw0RAQwaxJBqcWrzNc5I?purpose=fullsize)

**Basic AI agent**

## \$3,000–\$15,000

1–3 weeks, approximately

Automates one well-defined task, such as classifying emails, answering questions from documents, or drafting responses for approval.

---

![AI Workflows: Definition, Function and Examples of Use](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0SWnY9CSVpu7tnz3Qe0U3hMlQEsQFzKHq5R660jIVsa8et7P_R2bQJ3B3s4_q9GFNalVuwaz42otByOzZ4od7Q-LO7y3RqgG-Ue3kZbn6GmT17DtY4wNGMO_Vn_LDoaiV99r_8AaAq5Gy_j7h7U9Ax2WossevTtk1126OiHOMRSRyr2mKKrhba4WyUwcl6X8?purpose=fullsize)

**Production business agent**

## \$15,000–\$75,000

4–12 weeks, approximately

Connects to systems such as a CRM, email, internal databases, or accounting software, with testing and error handling.

---

![Enterprise AI Agent Architecture Explained: Frameworks, Design Patterns, and Best Practices](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/phA0dVW4LKq4WfvNHh5AWV8A-GtlpeY-aPebwvMHob_DZBTYla_HxXmZKYJI5BMy8_cB1eARMpB0lmBNBh5hrNbNexyoqKRlP95TMtUdeTQ3Rk52i8Rzb17DKh6wHzZ0Sk9iorRchyjIgp2zG66MoqDRmkY1Ewwri3owGyXOIko6YKYPR2KuM4vnn1GdF5Zd?purpose=fullsize)

**Advanced or multi-agent system**

## \$75,000–\$250,000+

2–6+ months, approximately

Coordinates multiple agents, handles complex workflows, and includes advanced security, monitoring, evaluations, and compliance controls.

These are indicative planning ranges, not vendor quotes. Actual timelines and costs vary. Sources: 2026 vendor pricing research and published cost guides. [www.ayautomate.com](https://www.ayautomate.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[botgigs.com](https://botgigs.com/lp/ai-agent-development-company?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.nerdheadz.com](https://www.nerdheadz.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One important distinction: a chatbot that answers questions is usually cheaper than an agent that can actually take actions, update a CRM, process transactions, or coordinate several business processes.

## 3\. What makes one quote more expensive than another?

| Cost factor | Why it matters |
|--------|--------|
| Number of integrations | Connecting a CRM, ERP, email, and accounting system requires more engineering and testing. |
| Data quality | Messy documents and inconsistent records require extra preparation. |
| Autonomy | An agent that takes actions needs stronger validation and safeguards than one that drafts recommendations. |
| Security and compliance | Access controls, audit logs, and regulatory requirements add work. |
| Reliability | Testing, monitoring, recovery from failures, and human approval steps are essential for production. |
| Ongoing support | Model usage, hosting, monitoring, maintenance, and improvements can be recurring costs. |


Remember to budget for operating costs as well as development. Depending on usage, infrastructure, model API calls, and maintenance can materially increase the total cost of ownership. [www.nerdheadz.com](https://www.nerdheadz.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ayautomate.com](https://www.ayautomate.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[botgigs.com](https://botgigs.com/lp/ai-agent-development-company?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 4\. How I would choose a company

- **Budget under \$10,000\:** Look for a narrowly scoped, single-workflow project. Expedey and Codroon are possible starting points.
- **Budget \$10,000–\$50,000\:** Compare QueryNow, Codroon, MTD Technologies, and other firms with relevant production experience.
- **Budget \$50,000+\:** Consider a broader engineering partner if you need multiple integrations, complex workflows, or enterprise-level security and governance.

Before signing a contract, ask for a fixed scope, measurable acceptance tests, source-code ownership, deployment into accounts you control, and a clear breakdown of recurring costs.

## 4\. How I would choose a company

- **Budget under \$10,000\:** Look for a narrowly scoped, single-workflow project. Expedey and Codroon are possible starting points.
- **Budget \$10,000–\$50,000\:** Compare QueryNow, Codroon, MTD Technologies, and other firms with relevant production experience.
- **Budget \$50,000+\:** Consider a broader engineering partner if you need multiple integrations, complex workflows, or enterprise-level security and governance.

Before signing a contract, ask for a fixed scope, measurable acceptance tests, source-code ownership, deployment into accounts you control, and a clear breakdown of recurring costs.
